svg.title: TYPE_TRANSITION_BAY_TO_INSERT / _TO_RETRIEVE -> PlanBayTransitionJob()
svg.desc: Command one bay to change mode. Job 0 succeeds; job 1 is rejected because an AGV stands in the bay's ODP collision area, so it adds no event.
svg.metadata: ["Start: the request arrives. The map is working_state as the method first sees it; no events yet. Step through the method one table row at a time.", "Row 1. Make a scratch copy of the request's garage and apply every event already in the DAG, so the method sees the garage as earlier jobs will leave it. In this example: Job 1 replays event 1 first. (replay)", "Row 2. The bay must exist and be enabled. In this example: B21 and B7 are enabled. (passes)", "Row 3. The bay's ODP collision area must be clear of AGVs and trays in the scratch garage. In this example: Job 0: nothing near B21. Job 1: AGV C stands in B7's ODP area, so job 1 fails here. (job 1 fails)", "Row 4. Insert mode can only be entered from retrieve mode. In this example: Job 1 never gets here. (not reached)", "Row 5. Retrieve mode needs a floor (the bay's first system floor) and starts from insert mode or a car inserted. In this example: Job 0: B21 is READY_TO_INSERT. (passes)", "Row 6. Any other command is rejected. In this example: (skipped)", "Row 7. Add the bay transition, chained after the bay's previous event (rule A) and earlier events of the job (rule B). In this example: Job 0 only. (adds 1)"]
